ENSEMBLE_CONFIG: web (or 'eval', or a versioned key such as '26-09_web' that pins the config and fails at startup if the installed chebifier ships a different one, or a path to a custom chebifier ensemble config listing the base learners; downloaded from Hugging Face for the named configs)
PR_CURVE: precision/recall curve of the ensemble over the decision threshold (optional; enables the precision/recall sliders)

<model name as keyed in the ensemble con.name: friendly display name shown in the web app
<model name as keyed in the ensemble con.description: HTML shown in the model info panel of the web app
